_doc: Gear and materials catalog. Owner: Agent 3 (content). Every obtainable character (First Ten + Solthrin) has 6 items: 2 weapon, 2 charm, 2 garment, each with a lore_reason tied to the character's canon contradiction. Stats use paths from game/combat/balance.json: '<character>.<key>' (full path where balance.json has that character section, otherwise a common actor key: hp, speed, accel, friction, dash_dist, dash_time, dash_iframes, dash_cd, poise) or 'global.*', 'pickups.*', 'burden.*'. op 'add' adds to the base value, 'mult' multiplies it. Epic and legendary items must carry a cost stat. 'hooks' are runtime effects listed in design/DATA_REQUESTS.md. source.region + source.kind (act|quest|secret) + source.ref points at an entry in game/canon/regions/<region>.json whose reward_gear lists the item.

items.name: Apprentice's Plumb Apron
items.lore_reason: A Spanwright apprentice's apron, far too small for him now. He keeps wearing it because the first lesson was never about monuments, and he is still learning it.

items.name: Ironroot Haft
items.lore_reason: Morrow rides an ironroot haft grown by Reach hands. Aruun wanted marble; ironroot flexes under load, which is why it never breaks.

items.name: Keth Well Stone
items.lore_reason: A smooth pebble from the bottom of the Keth wells. The kind of work he once called beneath him now keeps a plateau alive.

items.name: Two-Path Cable Loop
items.lore_reason: A cable loop braided with two load paths, one always hidden. It is the lesson his teacher spent years trying to give him: a good structure never announces its safety.

items.name: Eleven-Minute Shell Wrap
items.lore_reason: His fractured shell, refitted with Spanwright cable after the Red Span. Every seam is a record of the eleven minutes he carried a bridge, and of the hundreds he could not.

items.name: Foundation-Cut Morrow Head
items.lore_reason: A resting block of Thoughtstone from the foundation room, shaped into a new head for Morrow. It answers faster than he commands, and he refuses to call it a weapon, because he wants it to hold things up.

items.name: Wish-Line Knots
items.lore_reason: A knot of hanging-line charms. Each is a wish she is not sure she believes in, which is precisely why she keeps them close.

items.name: Bough-Walker Wrap
items.lore_reason: A light wrap the shelf-keepers use on slick boughs. She learned from the hall that certainty is a rope you test before you trust.

items.name: Sphere of Second Thoughts
items.lore_reason: A crown sphere that hums when she is about to doubt herself. She has learned to fire it anyway.

items.name: Calder's Compass
items.lore_reason: A surveyor's compass Wren Calder left behind. It points somewhere certain, and Cigarra keeps it because she cannot bring herself to hate how that feels.

items.name: Long Bough Cloak
items.lore_reason: Her treehopper-wing cloak, re-sewn with leaves shed by the Long Bough. It lets her step off the path she foresaw, and she loves how it hides her from her own visions.

items.name: Dead-Route Crown Sphere
items.lore_reason: A black sphere etched with every route that has died. It shows her nothing of the future, only what was truly crossed, and that is the first certainty she has ever trusted.

items.name: Pocket Reservoir
items.lore_reason: A corked vial of plankton light. Nerit carries it the way others carry a coin: to give away, not to spend.

items.name: Hooded Lantern
items.lore_reason: A lantern that works by hiding most of its own light. It is the only kind of lamp Nerit trusts.

items.name: Mourning Veil
items.lore_reason: A veil of bell moss given by the family at the pool. It carries the lesson that darkness can be a gift to the grieving.

items.name: Cycle-Dimmer Ring
items.lore_reason: A ring tuned from a Dominion lamp core to dim on the cave's own cycle. Nerit turned a tool of exposure into a tool of rest.

items.name: Sealed-Door Cowl
items.lore_reason: A cowl woven from threads gathered around the vault door. Wearing it, Nerit feels what the door wants: to be left alone.

items.name: Stilled Lantern
items.lore_reason: A lamp that has never been lit, filled with light that stopped moving long ago. Nerit can relocate it anywhere, and has sworn to light it only for those who ask.

items.name: Rain Palm Cloak
items.lore_reason: A rain-palm cloak that sheds the first storm. Mollusk wears it knowing that shedding rain is not the same as outrunning it.

items.name: Interest Ledger Bead
items.lore_reason: A bead strung to his shell for every delay he has bought. It is heavier than it looks, and he refuses to take it off.

items.name: Faced-Tide Shell Wrap
items.lore_reason: A shell wrap carved with the night the flood came due. Every mark is a consequence he chose to face rather than dodge.

items.name: Levee Spade
items.lore_reason: A broad spade used to patch the Long Levee. In Mollusk's hands it is a tool for slowing the water long enough for someone to finish the real repair.

items.name: Neema's Carving Point
items.lore_reason: A bone point used to mark old shell growth. Neema gave it to him to remind him that every debt has a name, and that paying it is a way of being remembered.

items.name: Unfinished Anchor-Hook
items.lore_reason: A heavy hook left in the drowned chapel, with a loop of shell cord still unfinished. It holds a structure in an unfinished state, and it never lets him forget that unfinished is not the same as safe.

items.name: Witness Ribbon Knot
items.lore_reason: A ribbon from the witness post, knotted around one wrist. It is the one thing Zephyr never bends.

items.name: Loophole-Lined Coat
items.lore_reason: A coat with a pocket in every seam, each holding a promise Zephyr has found a way to keep. It is the best argument for wording that has ever been stitched.

items.name: Kept-Word Locket
items.lore_reason: A locket that holds the read-aloud promise from the night bloom. It is warm only when its owner has kept every word they gave.

items.name: Pollen Fan
items.lore_reason: A fan of silk poppy petals given at the witness post. It stirs the air and the room, and has never once been used against a vow.

items.name: Courier's Wind Cape
items.lore_reason: A cape the relay captain awards to anyone who delivers on time. Zephyr treats it as a contract, and wears it as a signature.

items.name: Everbloom Sprig
items.lore_reason: A sprig from the gate that is always open, because no one has ever broken a promise there. A game in Zephyr's hands, and a vow in his heart.

items.name: Boundary Thread Charm
items.lore_reason: A single boundary thread, knotted. It is the smallest border Nyxaris owns, and the one she defends most fiercely.

items.name: Evidence Silk Mantle
items.lore_reason: A mantle woven from the tension patterns that prove the forgery. It is beauty built for a courtroom.

items.name: Contract-Torn Spindle
items.lore_reason: A spindle that once held Helix's sampling letter. She tore the letter and kept the tool, to remember who asked and who did not.

items.name: Tension Needle
items.lore_reason: A silksmith's needle that finds the wrong note in any web. It exists to protect authorship, which to her is a form of control and also a form of love.

items.name: Ring-Rewoven Pendant
items.lore_reason: A pendant woven from the rewoven bloom ring. The pattern is beautiful and unbreakable, and she made it that way on purpose.

items.name: The Unworn Garment
items.lore_reason: A garment from the origin nursery, never worn. It is the first thing her people ever made to be beautiful and safe at once.

items.name: Keeper's Cairn Chain
items.lore_reason: A chain link from the cairn of bridge-keeper names. He keeps other people's names without ever explaining his own.

items.name: Wrong-Direction Lens
items.lore_reason: A lens cut from a leaf of the Silent Crown, where even prophecy goes blank. He looks through it at Cigarra's blind spot, and says nothing.

items.name: Threshold Wrap
items.lore_reason: A wrap taken from the door keeper who asked not to be pressed. Pharilux wears it as a promise that he will not press anyone else.

items.name: Hour-Mist Beacon
items.lore_reason: His amber beacon, refilled with the mist of the hour when no rain fell. It burns steadily and tells him nothing about where it came from.

items.name: Amber Oath Mantle
items.lore_reason: A mantle sealed in amber from the cellar of oaths. The only thing he will say of it is that the oath inside it is not his, and it is kept anyway.

items.name: Archive Ice Bell
items.lore_reason: A chip of the cold archive that carries one small, true record. He studies it for an uncomfortably long time, and then returns it to his pocket.

items.name: Reach Fair Scale
items.lore_reason: A brass scale balanced to Reach standards. He refuses to rig it, and it costs him sleep every time.

items.name: Wish-Line Pin
items.lore_reason: A tiny pin from the charm line. It is worth nothing to anyone but its owner, and he will not sell it.

items.name: Glass Eel Scale Vest
items.lore_reason: A vest of clear scales taken from a net he refused to fill. The light that gets caught in it is the only thing he has ever been proud to waste.

items.name: Dockhand's Loader Cap
items.lore_reason: A cap left in the forklift's cab. He recognizes the stitching of someone who loved their work, and does not price it.

items.name: Snare Cutters
items.lore_reason: Wire cutters he now carries as a quiet apology. He exposes traffickers because captivity is bad for long-term commerce, and also because it is wrong.

items.name: The Not-For-Sale Ledger
items.lore_reason: A ledger with one page left blank and stamped NOT FOR SALE, given by the reliquary of the first silksmith. It is the first thing he ever received that he did not try to value.

items.name: Below-Hearing Tuning Fork
items.lore_reason: A tuning fork that rings below a beetle's hearing. It taught Solmara that a whole herd's distress can be heard before a single creature's, and that she must listen for both.

items.name: Flock-Turn Chart
items.lore_reason: A chart of a skimmer flock's turns, drawn like a tide table. She can predict the flock, not yet the person watching it.

items.name: Pulse Grammar Gloss
items.lore_reason: A glossary pinned inside her shell. She can now translate a swarm. A friend is harder.

items.name: Linh's Brass Gauge
items.lore_reason: A brass gauge that reads a river's mood. Linh gave it to Solmara after Solmara read it correctly, and then, to everyone's surprise, asked Linh how she was feeling.

items.name: Night-Bloom Moon Shawl
items.lore_reason: A shawl dusted with night-bloom pollen that opens only to moonlight. She felt the seeds tug at the same pull she feels in the tide.

items.name: Eclipse Vent Mantle
items.lore_reason: A mantle that holds heat on one side and cold on the other. It is her physiology, made wearable, for people who have never needed it.

items.name: Chalk Exit Marker
items.lore_reason: A stub of chalk and a ring of tags for marking exits. Every plan he has ever made began with the way out.

items.name: Rescue Harness
items.lore_reason: A harness the root weavers rigged under the fallen limb. He admires it: it is a plan, and not a hero.

items.name: Lantern-Lull Cloak
items.lore_reason: A cloak that dims with its wearer's breath. He wore it to guide a child out of the dark, and has not taken it off.

items.name: Stilt Row Whistle
items.lore_reason: A whistle for ordering an evacuation, house by house. He carried it through every drill of his career and is pleased to finally hold one that has saved a row.

items.name: Silk-Wrapped Diplomacy Grip
items.lore_reason: A grip of nursery silk for the thorned weapon he calls Diplomacy. The thorns do the talking, and the silk reminds him that it is better not to.

items.name: Diplomacy, Vigil Edition
items.lore_reason: His thorned weapon, wound with night-vigil ribbon. A soldier who sat a whole night to protect hares and never raised it. That is exactly the point of its name.

items.name: Dust-Crossing Lamp
items.lore_reason: A lamp lit from the grazer trail. It marks the one road across the gap that is worth leaving open.

items.name: Closed-Route Bough
items.lore_reason: A cut bough from a bridge closed on purpose. It is the proof he needs that closing a path can be the kindest way to carry something forward.

items.name: Thorn-Grown Grove Cutting
items.lore_reason: An ember branch he grew inside a thorn gate. It remembers both the path that was opened and the one that was left closed.

items.name: Pump Schedule Lantern
items.lore_reason: A lantern lit with the shared pumping schedule. It lights only the hours that were agreed on by everyone it affects.

items.name: Ice Road Harness
items.lore_reason: A harness rewoven for the ice road he helped reroute. It is a road for the caravans, and a border for the stalker, and he is content with both.

items.name: Unlit Road Mantle
items.lore_reason: A mantle woven from the ancestral sleeping hall's quiet. He lays paths through the dark, and learned here that some halls should have none.

materials.name: Reach Soil
materials.desc: Iron-rich soil bound by lichen.

materials.name: Lichen Culture
materials.desc: A living starter of mineral lichen.

materials.name: Thoughtstone Dust
materials.desc: Grit that pulses faintly near a bonded object.

materials.name: Thoughtstone Cache
materials.desc: A cut, resting block of Thoughtstone.

materials.name: Survey Salvage
materials.desc: Scrap from Dominion drones and rigs.

materials.name: Spanwright Cable
materials.desc: Braided, repaired cable that has never failed in service.

materials.name: Red Slate Plate
materials.desc: A shed carapace scale like layered slate.

materials.name: Keth Water Flask
materials.desc: Cold, clean well water in a sealed gourd. Restores a quarter of lost HP.

materials.name: Hopper Thread Silk
materials.desc: Strong, springy silk spun by thread hoppers.

materials.name: Pale Orchid Spray
materials.desc: A cluster of crown orchids that smell faintly of rain.

materials.name: Lantern Bracket Fungus
materials.desc: A soft-glowing shelf of fungus.

materials.name: Living Bridge Sap
materials.desc: Resin from a dying living bridge. It still remembers how to grow.

materials.name: Skimmer Veil Scrap
materials.desc: A translucent scrap of molted wing.

materials.name: Hopper Bead
materials.desc: A glass bead left on the charm line as a wish.

materials.name: Future Dust
materials.desc: A faint residue left where Premonition ghosts were thickest.

materials.name: Silent Leaf
materials.desc: A leaf from the Silent Crown. Nothing can be seen through it.

materials.name: Plankton Light Vial
materials.desc: A corked vial of living light. Restores Nerit's light reserve.

materials.name: Crystal Fern Frond
materials.desc: A frond that opens only under particular colors.

materials.name: Glass Eel Scale
materials.desc: A clear scale that holds a captured glimmer.

materials.name: Bell Moss
materials.desc: Soft moss that rings when touched.

materials.name: Spire Shard
materials.desc: A shard of mineral spire that stores a faint hum.

materials.name: Survey Lamp Core
materials.desc: A steady, lifeless light source from a Dominion lamp.

materials.name: Constellation Thread
materials.desc: A thread of drifting colony light spun into a filament.

materials.name: Stilled Light
materials.desc: A pool of light that stopped moving long ago.

materials.name: Rain Palm Fiber
materials.desc: Water-shedding fiber stripped from rain palms.

materials.name: Giant Taro Root
materials.desc: A starchy root that restores a little HP and a little patience.

materials.name: Mudback Shell
materials.desc: A thick crab shell, banded in gray and gold.

materials.name: Levee Clay
materials.desc: Dense blue clay used to patch earthen walls.

materials.name: Storm Heron Plume
materials.desc: A long gray plume that stays dry in any weather.

materials.name: Blank Shell Plate
materials.desc: A polished shell plate waiting for a mark.

materials.name: Forklift Part
materials.desc: A strangely beloved machine part.

materials.name: Hour Mist
materials.desc: A jar of the mist that stood over the river for one hour.

materials.name: Bell Briar Bud
materials.desc: A small bell-shaped bud that rings in wind.

materials.name: Honey Thistle Comb
materials.desc: Sweet, sticky comb. Restores HP and makes everyone a little friendlier.

materials.name: Silk Poppy Petal
materials.desc: A petal that never wrinkles.

materials.name: Ladder Vine Cord
materials.desc: A springy, strong cord of vine.

materials.name: Hare Whisker Bundle
materials.desc: Fine whiskers shed in a warren.

materials.name: Thorn Mantis Blade
materials.desc: A curved, shed foreblade, sharper than it looks.

materials.name: Witness Ribbon
materials.desc: A ribbon tied at the post when a vow is spoken.

materials.name: Amber Oath
materials.desc: A drop of honey amber that remembers a promise.

materials.name: Frost Silk Thread
materials.desc: Cold-reactive silk that tightens when it chills.

materials.name: Steam Lily Petal
materials.desc: A warm petal. Restores a little HP and cures the chill.

materials.name: Cinder Moss
materials.desc: A warm, dry moss that burns slowly.

materials.name: Rime Chitin
materials.desc: A frost-glazed plate from a rime beetle.

materials.name: Glass Thistle Seed
materials.desc: A faceted seed that rings faintly when struck.

materials.name: Voluntary Venom Vial
materials.desc: Venom given, not taken. Its source insists on the distinction.

materials.name: Archive Ice Chip
materials.desc: A chip of cold archive panel carrying a small, true record.

materials.name: The First Thread
materials.desc: A strand older than the region's boundary.
